content:
lina: Heads-up — opened PR for a tenant-onboarding example that walks through reserved pools, burst policy, and isolation labels. PR: #4217
sam: Nice. Which repo? docs or examples?
lina: sources: docs repo (website). File path in PR: /content/dedicated/onboarding/tenant-flow.md
mike: Can you add a minimal YAML snippet showing burst + cooldown? reviewers keep asking for that.
lina: Adding one. Draft snippet:
```yaml
reserved_pool: standard-4gpu
burst_policy:
  max_burst: 2
  cooldown_s: 300
isolation:
  tenant_label: team:payments
```
sam: Maybe show an SDK call too. Go + Python quick examples for ReserveCapacity and LabelTenant.
lina: I'll add Python snippet. Mike can you add Go?
mike: Yep. Go snippet coming. Will keep it small:
```go
client.Reserve(ctx, &ReserveOpts{Pool: "standard-4gpu", Tenant: "payments"})
```
laura: Small note on SLA wording: avoid "no preemption" — use "best-effort isolation with eviction mitigation" per legal. I'll paste suggested sentence later.
docs-bot: PR 4217 added reviewers: laura, mike, sam
sam: Also broken link in handbook: /handbook/dedicated/scale-policy -> needs to point to /handbook/dedicated/autoscale. I can fix in same PR.
lina: Great — please add link fix commit. Also can we add a one-line "when to choose dedicated vs hosted" FAQ block?
mike: Strongly +1. Short bullets only.
laura: SLA sentence suggestion: "Dedicated pools provide isolation guarantees subject to reserved capacity contracts; preemption is possible for non-reserved workloads and is covered under the SLA escalation flow." Thoughts?
sam: Good. Maybe shorten: "Isolation is guaranteed for reserved commits; short-notice preemption can affect burst capacity and is covered by our SLA remediation process."
lina: We'll iterate in PR. Action items: lina (update MD + add snippets), mike (Go snippet + one-liner FAQ), sam (link fix + merge checklist), laura (SLA wording). Targeting merge by EOD Friday.
mike: Quick question on examples: should we show KV cache settings? that feels runtime-y for docs.
sam: Keep KV cache out of onboarding, link to Optimize guide instead.
lina: OK. I'll link to Optimize guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217
laura: +1 on merge timeline if docs-bot checks green.
docs-bot: CI passed on PR 4217 — spellcheck and links OK
sam: I'll do a final pass tomorrow morning.
lina: Thanks team :heart:
